label: FY28 School Committee Budget Version 1 Memo

cuts.item: Restoration of four previously eliminated elementary teaching positions (two at the Primary School, two at Turkey Hill Elementary)

statements.statement: FY2028 preliminary budget (Version 1) printed as $30,145,083.11; a preliminary budget, not the recommended budget.
Proposed increase over FY2027 comparison budget, printed as $2,931,702.61 (10.77%).
Special education: approximately $650,000 in combined increases across transportation, tuition and related-service accounts.
Health insurance: preliminary 12% increase, approximately $537,000; better rate information expected January or February.
Utilities: approximately $101,000 increase in systemwide electricity costs.

warnings.prediction: Outstanding variables (health insurance, staffing and salary assumptions, special ed offsets, Circuit Breaker, School Choice, Net School Spending, town contribution) may materially change the amount ultimately requested in appropriations.
Not every request can be funded; the district will identify the impact if particular investments cannot be funded.
